svg.title: Uncle Damage
svg.desc: The announcer's face. Same artwork as the UncleDamage component in src/components/art.tsx, kept as its own file because a favicon is requested before any JS runs. The viewBox is tightened to the drawing's own bounds (the circle plus its 5px stroke, centred on 60,62) rather than art.tsx's 0 0 120 120, so the face fills a 16px browser tab instead of sitting in empty margin. The two colours are the ink and pink design tokens, written out because a standalone SVG has no stylesheet to read them from.
